main_text.l: Deorum cultus viritim, gregatimque, discordia ignota, &
ægritudo omnis, mors nō nisi fatietate vitæ, epulis, delibu-
tisque fenibus luxu, ex rupe quadam in mare salientibus,
hoc genus sepulturæ beatissimum. Quidam eos in prima
parte Asiæ littorum posuere, non in Europa, qui sunt ibi
similitudine & situs, Attacorum nomine. Alij medios fe-
cere eos inter utrumque Solem Antipodum, occasum ex-
orientemque nostrum, quod fieri nullomodo poteft tam
vasto mari interveniente. Qui non alibi, quam in seme-
stri luce constituere eos, sercere[?] matutinis, meridie mete-
re, occidente sole fœtus arborum decerpere, noctibus in
specus condi tradiderunt.

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top of the page. Heading "Antistrophe 2." is a small title set apart (level 3); the numeral is uncertain. Greek glosses are partly illegible at this scan resolution: Greek words marked [?] are best readings, and several Greek forms (e.g. "πόλιτα", "βάσαγς", "βάπτης", "βλήμια", "ἀνέμοις") should be checked against the original. "sercere" is uncertain and may be "ferere". The bottom-right mark is a gathering signature. The page ends with a hyphenated word "prae-" continuing on the next page. An ink spot at the right margin near the first lines is not printed text and is omitted.
